title: Toledo — Equation Library of the Human–AI Readout Programme
description: The permanent, coded registry of every equation in the Human–AI Readout Programme together with its Coq (Th_coqc) formalisation. Th_coqc certifies that a lemma is closed under a stated finite model's global context — an internal-consistency check, never an empirical or physical truth claim. v1.8 registers 1,302 entries (610 root rows). Additions: (1) an Internal-Consistency ladder (IC-0…IC-3, `docs/CONSISTENCY_SPEC_v0_1.md`) — a grader over seven equation-clearing audit dimensions (schema, structure, tier, symbols, coq, duplicates, lineage) writing read-only sidecars under `registry/consistency/`, orthogonal to and never merged with the resistance ladder R0–R6; a same-day fix ensures every passing dimension names the cells it actually examined (`evidence.cells`), never leaving a never-checked cell indistinguishable from a checked-clean one; corpus reading: 1,912 sidecars, 0 at IC-3 yet (no independent clearance file exists); (2) one Religious Attribution Non-Collapse reading (weld/H.51.v1, a five-level non-collapse chain over model output/policy/institution/belief/religious-classification); (3) 27 causal-memory root-extension readings from a founder-instructed sweep of causal-memory-programme records, each coq_status `open_prop` with its own individually-compiled Coq open-proposition stub, tier exactly as its own source states (introducing Theorem/Empirical/Postulate/Lemma/Conjecture tier labels, carried verbatim rather than collapsed); (4) one URCF turbulence reading (weld/P.05.v1, the retained-information relaxation-inertia turbulence prediction equation), instance_of the existing Finite-Memory Laplacian/Telegraph Generator and structurally matched (not author-cited) to root EQ-008, explicitly disclosed as NOT resolving Genesis root gap T2 (the easier linear/time-invariant sub-case only). EQ-001/P.45.v1's disclosed sympy misparse (from v1.7's Executable Equations pilot) was reviewed and set `reviewed_ineligible`; EQ-001/P.63.v1 built and cross-checked in its place. Reproduction evidence is otherwise unchanged from v1.7 (gauge-algebra dimension check PASS, Higgs-mass prediction FAIL against the published PDG value, IDM ladder-constants check PASS); R5 (independent reviewer) is still unheld for every entry. Ships a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and command-line client (21 tools over stdio, a SQLite/FTS5 search index, and a static read API published on GitHub Pages) that lets an AI agent look an equation up before using it, plus a human-readable documentation site on the same GitHub Pages deployment. Each entry carries an honest coq_status (closed, definition, wrapped_related, mapped_not_wrapped, axioms, open_prop, or not_formalisable). Scope: equations and Th_coqc only; papers, books and prose live in their own records and cite Toledo codes.
